review:
A gothic tumbling game on 5x4 – and surprisingly gentle for Nolimit. Wins get destroyed and the rest drop, while a Ritual Bar below the reels counts destroyed symbols towards bonus levels: each level adds two Candle Spins, plus six more for reaching Cursed Spins.

Sticky wilds land on reels 2 to 5, and in the bonus they drop to the bottom and stay until they join a win. xSplit only shows up in Cursed Spins. Medium volatility, 6,666x max, 96.13% RTP. A great first Nolimit game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
